BF16_reference.quality: Same48 synthetic input frames; INT8 result /128 equals exact BF16/FP32 result. External output-format conversion omitted on both sides.

boundary: N64 one-output compute core: four INT8 products with product pipeline, balanced integer reduction, output-stationary AW32/AW22 sum and control. Async control reset with4.5..5.5ns release contract; synchronous sum reset; product flops valid-masked and not reset. No input/weight memory, output conversion, RNG, real broadcast, ICG/CTS/SDF/SPEF. Synthetic inputs; no model/PPL or silicon signoff.
